# Now 2.10.74
- Fixed Apple Music songs showing no overlay lyrics even while Music displayed synchronized lyrics. - Apple Music now uses its locally cached, authenticated timed-lyrics payload first, with strict title, artist, and duration validation and no lyric text written to diagnostics. - Added support for both Apple line-timed and word-timed TTML lyric formats. - Short retry windows recover when Music writes its lyric response just after playback metadata arrives. - YouTube Music’s LRCLIB fallback now checks alternate synchronized records when the canonical record contains only plain lyrics.

# Now 2.10.73
- Added an “Artist with lyrics” option under Artwork & Lyrics settings. - When the artist is hidden, lyrics reserve a stable two-line region so short and wrapped lyric lines no longer move the title vertically. - The preference persists independently from the normal Track Info artist setting and defaults to the existing visible-artist behavior. - If synchronized lyrics are unavailable, the overlay still falls back to the original title-and-artist layout.

# Now 2.10.72
- Fixed Apple Music's native queue preview being skipped because normal Apple Music playback was routed through MediaRemote rather than the AppleScript fallback. - Next-track artwork now prefetches on the normal Apple Music route and whenever source routing changes without a track change. - Restored clearly visible, finger-tracked artwork movement for partial swipes while a neighboring cover is still loading or unavailable. - Retains the resolved Up Next artwork and stale-response validation introduced in 2.10.71.
